item.title: Event Types
item.description: This page lists all event types that can be generated by Trustgrid nodes. Events are alphabetized and grouped by their filter type. For events that have both trigger and resolution states, the trigger severity and resolution severity are shown. item.title: Events
item.description: Events are emitted from nodes and from the Trustgrid control plane when actionable things happen. Events are the basis for alarms and notifications. Events can be viewed for individual nodes by navigating to Events under the History section. Viewing events requires events::read permissions. Clicking the Test button will send the event through your configured alarms to help verify channels are configured as expected. Event Times Field Name Description Generated Time The time the event was created.

item.title: Organization Events
item.description: This page shows events from all nodes in an organization. Events are emitted from nodes and from the Trustgrid control plane when actionable things happen. Events are the basis for alarms and notifications. Organization events are available by navigating to Operations > Events. This is the same data visible on a node’s Events page, with the addition of a Node column and the ability to filter by specific node names in Advanced Search.
